races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Fairye Forth
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 340-day break with Sean Bowen's booking suggesting hidden improvement despite lightly raced profile.

runners_data.name: Seven Kites
runners_data.note: Unknown pace style after single career run makes tactical approach unpredictable, but Tom Lacey's 0/6 recent record raises trainer form concerns.

runners_data.name: Royal Rocket
runners_data.note: Prominent runner suited to this pace setup with Emma Lavelle in good form (7/19) and proven on similar soft going.

runners_data.name: Tobyshill
runners_data.note: Front runner wearing first-time headgear with RPR 116 giving him competitive claims if he can sustain his kick when challenged.

runners_data.name: Jonny Setaside
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits the race shape but apprentice Finn Lambert's 3lb claim may not compensate for horse's moderate recent efforts.

runners_data.name: Equity Release
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 131-day break with 7lb weight allowance but poor trainer form (0/2) raises preparation concerns.

runners_data.name: Country Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with modest early pace, though RPR 127 class edge and proven headgear give him chances if race develops favorably.

races.paceDynamic: Tobyshill will lead this small field and set his own fractions without early pressure from the prominent runners Royal Rocket, Jonny Setaside and Equity Release. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, allowing the field to travel comfortably in behind. Seven Kites and Fairye Forth bring unknown pace angles as lightly raced horses, while Country Park sits as the only confirmed hold-up performer. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed — the modest early pace will keep the field compact and reward horses that can quicken from handy positions rather than those relying on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays modest and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early burn-up allows prominent runners to conserve energy and unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions. Tobyshill's uncontested lead becomes vulnerable when the fresher, higher-rated horses close from just behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Tobyshill's recent form boost and headgear change help him sustain his kick when challenged
scenarios.body: The modest pace plays into his hands as he faces no early pressure, and his RPR 116 rating gives him competitive claims. Country Park and other hold-up types get caught too far back when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly mid-race and strings out the field more than expected
scenarios.body: Country Park's class advantage (RPR 127) and proven hold-up style allow him to pick off tired leaders despite the tactical setup. His trainer's poor recent form becomes irrelevant if the race falls apart up front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Seven Kites or Fairye Forth possess hidden ability that their limited exposure hasn't revealed
scenarios.body: Their unknown pace styles could include tactical speed that suits this race shape perfectly. Sean Bowen's booking of Fairye Forth despite Rebecca Curtis's poor form suggests stable confidence in a horse returning from a long break.

watchPoints.text: Country Park needs the pace to quicken significantly mid-race to bring his hold-up style into play against this tactical setup.
Tobyshill's first-time headgear and 18-day turnaround suggest connections expect improvement from his recent third place effort.
Seven Kites' single career run provides no tactical blueprint, making his pace approach completely unpredictable in a small field.
Equity Release returns from a 131-day break with trainers showing 0/2 recent form, raising questions about his fitness levels.
Royal Rocket's prominent style and proven soft ground form make him well-suited to exploit any weakening of Tobyshill's early lead.

races.name: LSL Racing Horse Sales - Syndication - Leasing Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hurricane Pat

runners_data.name: Mistral St Georges
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.comment: In the process of running well when falling two out on Newbury debut
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 for last month's debut at Newbury (2m, good to soft) but very much in contention before falling heavily at penultimate flight; has possibilities if that experience did not dent his confidence.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Connection
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent course form (1/1) and Harry Cobden partnership signals serious intent

runners_data.name: Good Girl Rachel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from in-form Ben Clarke stable but lacks the class for this level

runners_data.name: Crystal Box
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but has shown tendency to fade in finish, making Tom Broughton's 5lb claim valuable

runners_data.name: Modern Style
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 129-day break, needs the run but has shown ability

runners_data.name: Are You Joking
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has disappointed lately but Richie McLernon retains the ride

runners_data.name: Both Of Us
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with useful course record (1W2P from 14 runs) and first-time tongue-tie applied

runners_data.name: One For Rian
runners_data.note: Unconventional style runner from in-form Neil Mulholland yard (4/26 recent record)

runners_data.name: Play On Court
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent RPR of 111 and perfect record on similar going

runners_data.name: Below The Belt
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but tendency to fade suggests lack of finishing kick for this level

runners_data.name: Bowling Shane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 34-day break with Ned Fox's 3lb claim to help

races.paceDynamic: Hurricane Pat stands alone as the clear pace-setter with his prominent/lead style and class edge (OR 142), likely to dictate terms from the front without pressure from fellow front runners. The majority of the field comprises hold-up horses (Cosmic Connection, Crystal Box, Modern Style, Both Of Us, Below The Belt, Bowling Shane) who will need the pace to develop and gaps to appear in the straight. With Good Girl Rachel, Are You Joking, and Play On Court providing some prominent cover behind Hurricane Pat, the race will develop into a typical scenario where the leader sets sustainable fractions before the hold-up brigade launches late challenges. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — Hurricane Pat may go too fast too early under pressure, and the patient riders will benefit from the guaranteed pace and late tactical opportunities.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Pat goes too keen early or the pace becomes genuine enough to set up the back markers
scenarios.body: The class act Hurricane Pat either burns out or gets swamped by fresher finishers who've conserved energy. Hold-up specialists like Cosmic Connection and Both Of Us can unleash their finishing kicks when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hurricane Pat wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Pat gets an easy lead and controls the pace on his own terms
scenarios.body: The class horse uses his superior rating and Tom Cannon's tactical nous to dictate a steady pace before quickening when ready. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do against a horse in career-best form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent horses bridge gap
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners (Good Girl Rachel, Are You Joking, Play On Court) track Hurricane Pat closer than expected
scenarios.body: A sustained pace develops with the mid-pack runners getting first run on the tiring leader but holding off the hold-up horses. This creates the perfect scenario for horses who can travel and finish without being too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Pat goes very slowly and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical speed matters more than stamina, potentially suiting horses with natural pace regardless of their usual running style. This could throw up a surprise result from the lower-rated runners.

watchPoints.text: Hurricane Pat may go too keen if challenged early by the prominent runners, compromising his stamina reserves
Both Of Us first-time tongue-tie and Kerry Lee's booking of Tom Cannon suggests serious stable confidence
Cosmic Connection has perfect course form and Harry Cobden only rides live chances for Chris Gordon
Crystal Box and Below The Belt both have warnings for fading in the finish from their previous runs
Neil Mulholland's yard is in good form (4/26) making One For Rian interesting at likely big odds

runners_data.name: Touquet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with hat-trick achieved, RPR 122 suggests he's at peak of powers

runners_data.name: Brulure Noire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with outstanding soft ground record (4W8P), returning from 107-day absence under Harry Bannister

runners_data.name: Diligent Militia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing tongue-tie for first time, concerning lack of recent form with Tim Vaughan 0/6 in last 14 days

runners_data.name: Supreme George
runners_data.note: Front-running specialist with recent proximity, ridden by 3lb claimer Charlie Maggs for in-form Donald McCain yard

races.paceDynamic: Supreme George will set a controlled pace from the front with no pressure from other front runners. The prominent Touquet should track him, but three hold-up horses (Le Gentleman, Brulure Noire, Diligent Militia) will settle at the back. With Supreme George allowed to dictate terms uncontested, he can set fractions that suit his stamina and kick when he chooses. This setup strongly favours the front runner and any prominent racers who can stay close — the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with no pace pressure to soften up the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Supreme George Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Supreme George gets uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: He can quicken off steady pace when ready, making it hard for hold-up horses to peg him back. Touquet tracking closely gives him best chance to respond if leader kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Touquet Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Touquet can stay close enough and Supreme George's stamina cracks
scenarios.body: The in-form gelding has been winning regularly and can use his class edge to wear down the leader. His prominent style lets him pick the right moment to challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes faster than expected and leaders weaken
scenarios.body: Brulure Noire's excellent soft ground record (4W8P from 15 runs) makes him dangerous if getting the run of the race. His hold-up style benefits from a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Supreme George goes too slow and field bunches up turning in
scenarios.body: Sprint finish favours horses with tactical speed rather than stamina. Le Gentleman's hold-up style could work if he gets clear run in messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Supreme George gets uncontested lead - if no early pressure he can dictate the race on his terms
Touquet's early position - needs to track the leader closely enough to respond when pace lifts
First-time tongue-tie on Diligent Militia could spark improvement after recent poor runs
Brulure Noire returning from 107-day break - watch for signs of rustiness despite excellent going record
Le Gentleman's jumping under pressure - has shown tendency to fade and make mistakes when tired

runners_data.name: Blow Your Wad

runners_data.name: Olivers Travels
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 152-day break but showed excellent form before the layoff with two wins from three starts

runners_data.name: Miralago

runners_data.name: Knight Of Allen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent recent form with a win and second from last two starts, ideally positioned for this pace scenario

runners_data.name: Torneo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from the in-form Jamie Snowden yard who excels on soft ground with strong recent placings

runners_data.name: Ben Solo
runners_data.note: The lone front runner who will dictate terms but his recent form shows inconsistency despite winning two starts ago

runners_data.name: Soldierofthestorm

runners_data.name: Jaipaletemps

races.paceDynamic: Ben Solo provides the only confirmed early pace with his leading style, setting up a sustainable tempo without pressure from the field. The prominent runners Blow Your Wad, Miralago, Soldierofthestorm and Jaipaletemps will track in behind, while the hold-up trio of Olivers Travels, Knight Of Allen and Torneo settle towards the rear. With just one front runner and multiple closers, the pace should be measured early before quickening from the home turn. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — Ben Solo faces no early pressure so the pace will be steady, allowing closers to sweep up late in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ben Solo sets his usual steady pace and the prominent horses don't apply early pressure.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from two out with plenty left in the tank for the closers who have been conserving energy. Knight Of Allen and Torneo use their superior finishing kicks to sweep past tiring front runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Blow Your Wad or Soldierofthestorm force the pace and make it a true test of stamina.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays to horses positioned in the second rank who can respond to pressure while avoiding the worst of the early burn. Soldierofthestorm and Jaipaletemps benefit from their recent winning form and tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Ben Solo gets away with very soft fractions and the field fails to organize a coherent challenge.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leaves too much to do for the hold-up horses over this shorter trip. Ben Solo uses his head start to hold off late challenges despite his inconsistent recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses are pulled up or fall, creating an attritional contest.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test rather than a tactical affair, suiting the most reliable jumpers. Horses with solid recent form and jumping records benefit from the chaos ahead of them.

watchPoints.text: Ben Solo must be watched for early fractions as he faces no pace pressure and could steal a march if allowed soft splits
Knight Of Allen's jumping needs monitoring as hold-up horses require clean jumps to deliver their finishing kick from off the pace
Olivers Travels returning from 152 days off - watch for signs of rustiness early but could be primed for a big effort fresh
The prominent quartet of Blow Your Wad, Miralago, Soldierofthestorm and Jaipaletemps could bunch up and interfere with each other
Torneo represents Jamie Snowden who has 3 winners from 15 runners in the last 14 days suggesting stable is in good form

runners_data.name: Lord Of All Saints

races.paceDynamic: Bluegrass looks the natural pace-setter with a confirmed front-running style and no obvious pressure from the field composition. The prominent runners So You Know, It's Top, Marlacoo, American Land, and Beau Quali are more likely to sit just off the pace rather than challenge Bluegrass for the early lead. This creates a controlled tempo with the large contingent of hold-up horses (Authentic Legacy, Torrent, Gold For Alec, Wolf Moon, Lord Of All Saints, Hackney Hill) positioned to strike late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — Bluegrass sets a manageable gallop that allows closers to time their challenges perfectly in the soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bluegrass sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate through the early stages
scenarios.body: The soft ground and steady tempo allows the strong contingent of hold-up horses to close powerfully, with Authentic Legacy and Wolf Moon perfectly positioned to exploit their tactical advantage. The pace-setters tire in the testing conditions as the closers sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply more pressure to Bluegrass and quicken the tempo approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: So You Know and It's Top are ideally placed to capitalize when the early pace increases, sitting close enough to strike but avoiding the worst of any early speed battle. Their forward positions prove decisive as they have first run on the tiring leader while the hold-up horses face too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bluegrass Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Bluegrass gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the lack of early pressure to build an insurmountable lead, finding enough stamina reserves in the soft ground to hold off late challengers. Stuart Edmunds' 2/13 recent record suggests the stable is in decent form to execute this front-running plan.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too fast early trying to track or challenge Bluegrass through the first half of the race
scenarios.body: The unsustainable early gallop sets up a sprint finish where the most patient hold-up horses with the best turn of foot can capitalize on a crawling pace scenario. Lord Of All Saints and Gold For Alec benefit most from this tactical meltdown as fresher finishers.

watchPoints.text: Bluegrass getting an uncontested lead through the early stages — if no prominent runners challenge him the race becomes a sitting duck scenario for hold-up horses
Authentic Legacy and Wolf Moon both returning from lengthy breaks exceeding 30+ days — fitness levels uncertain despite their tactical advantages
So You Know wearing first-time tongue-tie which could provide the extra sharpening needed to capitalize on his prominent running style
Multiple 7lb and 5lb claiming jockeys aboard key contenders including Torrent and Beau Quali may lack tactical nous in a competitive handicap
American Land returning from 166-day absence but Joe Tizzard's horses typically come back fit first-time and his front-running style could disrupt the pace

races.paceDynamic: Galassian looks the lone pace-setter with four horses (Bobalot, Groom De Cotte, Kingston Kid, The Italian Fox, Home And Dry) wanting prominent positions behind him, creating significant traffic issues. The pace should be steady rather than frantic with just one leader, but the prominent congestion will cause interference and positioning problems from 3 out as they fan out for their challenges. This setup moderately favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the scrimmaging and benefit from the solid gallop — Man Maid, Ffree Pedro and Dessie Haze should get the ideal race shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets into a battle for position turning in
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest enough to set up the race perfectly for the back markers, who avoid all the interference and get first run on a strung-out field. Man Maid and Dessie Haze can use their class to pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horse wins clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets a clear run and kicks before the others
scenarios.body: They can steal a march on the field while the others are still scrimmaging, with The Italian Fox or Groom De Cotte having the class and recent form to capitalize. The hold-up horses may be left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If Galassian goes too slow or gets headed early by the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning from the last hurdle is everything, suiting horses who can quicken rather than stay. Bobalot's higher RPR rating could prove decisive in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Galassian gets an easy lead and the prominent horses fail to pressure him
scenarios.body: Despite his modest recent form, he could pinch it if allowed to dictate completely uncontested. The longer distance and soft ground would aid his stamina, though his class looks modest for the grade.

watchPoints.text: Traffic problems 3 out as five prominent runners (Bobalot, Groom De Cotte, Kingston Kid, The Italian Fox, Home And Dry) converge behind Galassian
Kingston Kid making debut with tongue-tie and blinkers after poor recent form - equipment changes suggest issues
The Italian Fox returning quickly after 7 days with in-form Tizzard stable booking top jockey Powell
Home And Dry returning after 403 days off with first-time cheekpieces - huge fitness question
Man Maid getting ideal setup as hold-up horse with 3lb claiming allowance in competitive handicap
